name: appsync-eventbridge-sfn-cdk
description: Self-service workflow catalog: a GraphQL front door for Step Functions workflows, built with AppSync, EventBridge, Lambda, and DynamoDB

scripts.build: tsc && rm -rf dist/lambda dist/graphql && mkdir -p dist/lambda && cp lambda/*.py dist/lambda/ && cp -R graphql dist/ && python3 -m pip install --quiet --disable-pip-version-check --no-compile --no-deps --requirement lambda/requirements.txt --target dist/lambda
